limitations.statement: Full Draft 2020-12 validation remains degraded because no generic validator is installed.
SCC and cycle counts remain unavailable and are not presented as current metrics.
ProjectSession lifecycle shell plus ClimateState and ConstructionState slices are implemented; Thermal and Hydraulics state slices remain target-only and are not yet owned by ProjectSession.

invariants.statement: ProjectSession SHALL be the composite aggregate root for project lifecycle and identity without becoming a flat god object.
Climate values SHALL have one writable canonical owner in ProjectSession.ClimateState.
Construction values and layers SHALL have one writable canonical owner in ProjectSession.ConstructionState.
Thermal inputs SHALL be owned by ProjectSession.ThermalState and results derived.
Hydraulics inputs and collectors SHALL be owned by ProjectSession.HydraulicsState and results derived.
Every migrated value SHALL have exactly one writable canonical owner.
ViewModels SHALL be WPF adapters and not shared canonical state stores.
Application services SHALL NOT depend on concrete ViewModels.
Results SHALL be a derived projection and not a second canonical store.
Every reactive subscription SHALL have explicit owner, lifetime, unsubscribe rule, and multiplicity expectation.
New/load/second-load/reset/repeated-reset SHALL leave no stale state or multiplied subscriptions.
Supported .smc read behavior and wire format SHALL remain compatible unless owner-approved.
Restore SHALL have an explicit ordered coordinator boundary.
Production ownership migration SHALL proceed sequentially by vertical slice.
Target facts SHALL remain distinguishable from observed baseline/current facts.
ProjectSession lifecycle shell (identity, path, dirty, restore guard) SHALL be the sole writable canonical owner and SHALL NOT contain module slices.
